desc: 弹力素色圆领短袖，针织亲肤垂坠，弧形开衩下摆，通勤与轻运动皆可穿

name: 女士弹力圆领短袖素色基础款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清版型与前胸轮廓，用无干扰的合规主图争点击。
一秒法则：左衣右文两栏版面，用三条极短主张交代穿着体感与适用场合。
shots.textZone: 右栏三行细线分隔主张「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」，取值由真实卖点填充

shots.intent: 把上衣放进真实的清晨出门情境，让买家自我代入日常通勤穿法。
用手轻拉侧下摆的近景，证明下摆弧度与面料回弹垂坠而非平面示意。
以后侧 45 度交代后背无装饰的干净版型与后领高度，消除上身效果疑虑。
用领罗纹与肩颈走线的微距证据收口，以可见做工替代任何资质背书。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio cyclorama #FFFFFF for the packshot, warm off-white flat field #FBFAF8 for the callout screen, oat-toned plaster interior panelling #EFE9E0 and #E4DBCE for scenes, all kept low-contrast so the knit reads first
style.direction: clean basics-apparel ecommerce with minimal infographic screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rules and markers only, no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges
style.lightingSystem: bright soft 5600-5700K daylight-balanced key from upper left with gentle wrap fill, low-contrast contact shadows only, skimming light on knit textures, no harsh flash, no mixed colour casts
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean basics-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, oat warm background #EFE7DB, charcoal type #33373B and one soft sprout-green accent #A8B98F; neutral colour temperature throughout; one modern geometric sans-serif family with a light letter-spaced kicker above short callout lines, all rendered in-image copy wrapped in corner brackets and never as dense body text; background system of a seamless studio cyclorama, a warm off-white flat callout field and oat-toned plaster interior panelling; lighting system of bright soft 5600-5700K daylight-balanced key from upper left with gentle wrap fill, low-contrast contact shadows only, skimming light on knit surfaces, no harsh flash and no mixed colour casts; surface system of matte plaster mouldings, pale wood and the heathered knit fabric itself; layout system of generous margins, thin single-weight rules, one two-column image-plus-callout screen and consistent rounded card corners; icon system of thin single-weight line markers only, no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges; product presentation rules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, readable crew rib and sleeve line, stable scale and consistent front read, relaxed fully formed hands; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no identifiable faces, no brand marks, no watermarks.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting direction or colour temperature
no mismatched line-marker or icon styles
no identifiable model faces or source likeness
no brand marks, watermarks or QR codes
style.presentationRules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, crew rib and sleeve line always readable, stable front read across scenes so the garment reads as the same object, consistent scale, relaxed fully formed hands
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall with shallow mouldings, pale wood side table, and the heathered knit surface of the garment itself as the macro surface
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, light letter-spaced kicker above short callout lines, in-image copy only as bracketed placeholders, headline 24-32pt, labels 12-16pt, no dense body text
